title: Register detector Score in plexus.scores
description:
Register the programmatic detector Score in plexus.scores.resolve_score_class / _SCORE_CLASS_MODULES, following KeywordClassifier. Do not use Tactus.

Behavior is specified by the child story on this epic. DataParade scanner callable is DATAP task under DATAP-95d339.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Wave 5b started on feature/plx-611fbe-span-overlap-score from the Virtuus store branch. Register SourceSpanOverlapScore. No client product names. Tactus not used. Scanner JSON contract is filePath/startLine/endLine.
